note: The data behind skill-tree.svg. The picture is hand-authored; this file is
what keeps it honest. A leaf is validated only when a reference exists that
lets the skills work that path without reading an outside codebase, and
scripts/check-skill-tree.py fails the build when the two disagree.
One leaf, one directory under pathsDir, entered through its README.md.
Adding a leaf means: write the reference, add it here, draw it in the SVG.

statuses.validated: Built and run for real, and carried by a reference the skills load. Drawn solid.
statuses.validating: Blueprinted in the docs, first real service still proving it. Drawn amber.
statuses.open: Permitted by the core, not blueprinted. Reached through the open-path protocol in core.md. Drawn dashed.
